note: AgentBay is a cloud sandbox/agent-runtime product offered under Alibaba Cloud ("Aliyun"), the cloud-computing division of Alibaba Group Holding Limited, a publicly traded company (NYSE: BABA; HKEX: 9988). It is not an independent startup and has no accelerator history, independent funding rounds, or standalone revenue disclosure — buyers should treat it as a feature of a large public-company cloud platform rather than a venture-backed company with its own financial profile. Alibaba Group's own consolidated revenue (last public fiscal year) is in the ~US$130-140 billion range, but this figure covers the entire group, not AgentBay specifically, so product-level revenue is left unknown per the task's guidance for subsidiaries of larger companies.
